notes: Fixes and fail-safes. Cable TV: the hour that had nothing on when the clocks go back is filled, a show with bad data can't freeze the launcher, the player restarts if it crashes, and commercials set themselves up more reliably (and say plainly why when they can't). Movies & TV: the player always starts, even on an mpv that doesn't know the newer switches. Fail-safes: an update that can't show its screen twice in a row is dropped for the built-in version; a crashed or frozen screen reloads itself; a game is never left frozen if the launcher is killed; saved data survives a crash in the middle of a save; mistakes are written to errors.log.
